{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=L.

$$
\begin{aligned}L & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{9}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{4+81} \\  & =\sqrt{85} \\  & =\sqrt{85}.\end{aligned}
